requiredCases.purpose: Installed production metadata, native video, progress, pause and seek
Resize, enforced minimum, maximization and restored bounds across process restart
Accessible viewport and physical native child agree at the observed window DPI
Fullscreen fills its monitor and returns to the previous window bounds
Native dialog owns its parent, blocks underlying input and returns focus
Unfinished input survives clean process close and reopen through actual accessible controls
Actual 100/125/150 percent DPI samples and monitor moves with accessible/native video and usable work-area bounds
Real OS keyboard/clipboard and principal screen-reader operations; UIA value assignment alone is insufficient
Actual GPU/video pixels, dialogs, route transitions and clipping at normal and wide layouts
Windows Japanese IME preedit, candidate placement, commit and persistence
Measured output signal and timing; state explicitly whether direct listening occurred
Actual source interval and sentence-boundary playback stop at the intended media clock
Real long-duration source decode, seeking, transcript scrolling and recovery
Current GPUI playback on identified 1080p60 and 4K30 assets: CPU/GPU load, dropped frames and measured A/V sync with display size and criteria
